posts.title: NASA Science

posts.title: NASA Awards Contract to Develop 5G Communications for Moon
posts.lead: NASA has awarded Modulate Space Corporation a contract to develop key elements of a 5G communications system for use on the lunar surface with built-in Wi-Fi 6, for NASA’s Glenn Research Center in Cleveland.

posts.title: NASA, SpaceX Conclude Review, Crew-13 ‘Go’ for Launch
posts.lead: NASA, SpaceX, and international partner teams completed the Launch Readiness Review for the agency’s Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station, with mission leaders polling “go” to proceed into the launch count.

posts.title: Station Prepares to Welcome Crew-13 while Continuing Space Research
posts.lead: Expedition 75 is getting the International Space Station ready for the arrival of NASA’s SpaceX Crew-13 mission scheduled to launch and dock to the orbital outpost on Thursday, Oct. 1.
